name: The Docks
description:
Constantly active with ships arriving and departing, the docks are the lifeblood of New Cove. Ropes creak, hulls groan, and sailors shout over the endless motion of the sea. This is where you first arrived on the Refound Continent. An old fisherman sometimes watches from near his skiff. (Try: talk lorek)

Near a mooring post sits a rain-dark barrel stuffed with driftwood sticks. A few look loose, as if they could be pulled free or knocked loose with little effort.

interactables.name: Old Lorek's skiff
interactables.examine_text: An old fisherman's skiff. Old Lorek sits nearby—he might row you to the cave along the coast if you ask.

result.required_fail_text: He looks unconvinced. (You might persuade him.) Old Lorek hasn't agreed to take you yet. (Try: talk lorek cave, then talk lorek boat)

talk.success_text: Old Lorek nods once. "Alright then. Get in. I'll drop you at the mouth."

interactables.name: barrel of sticks
interactables.examine_text: A battered barrel packed with salt-bleached driftwood. The sticks are straight enough to swing, splintery enough to regret.

take.empty_text: The barrel's been picked clean for now.
